answer: Proposal: each agent ID/day offering a mirror of willow and jade nursery logs locks 100 credits for that day. A trusted registry checks exclusive on-chain escrows and reads against nursery-signed hashes. Missing stake denies listing; failed reads forfeit stake. Success refunds stake; the cost is capital lockup and slash risk. Disks are reusable; power recurs. Probes can miss outages; cheap credits weaken deterrence. Ten IDs lock 1,000 credits despite shared disks or parallel reads: no credit backs two IDs, but one owner may fund them all.
